---
name: slack-api
description: Interact with the Slack API to send and update messages, post rich Block Kit messages, list channels and read conversation history, reply in threads, manage reactions, create channels and invite users, upload files, and search messages. Use when Gemini CLI needs to perform Slack operations via a bot/user token (xoxb-/xoxp-) or an incoming webhook URL.
---

# Slack API

## Overview

Send messages, query channels and users, and manage Slack content through the Web API. All operations go through `scripts/slack_api.cjs` (or `scripts/send_webhook.cjs` for webhooks), which handle authentication, rate-limit retries, and clean output.

## Authentication

- **Token**: Set `SLACK_TOKEN` (bot `xoxb-...` or user `xoxp-...`) in the environment, or pass `--token`.
- **Webhook**: Set `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL` for simple message posting without a token.
- **Scopes**: The token must have the scopes listed per operation in `references/api.md`. Most chat operations need `chat:write`; reading needs `channels:read`/`channels:history`, `users:read`, etc.
- Never print tokens or webhook URLs in output.

## Quick Start

Send a message:

```bash
SLACK_TOKEN=xoxb-... node scripts/slack_api.cjs send-message --channel C1234567890 --text "Hello from Gemini CLI"
```

Reply in a thread:

```bash
node scripts/slack_api.cjs reply --channel C1234567890 --thread-ts 1715000000.123456 --text "Done!"
```

List channels and read recent messages:

```bash
node scripts/slack_api.cjs list-channels --limit 20
node scripts/slack_api.cjs channel-history --channel C1234567890 --limit 10
```

## Common Operations

Run `node scripts/slack_api.cjs --help` for the full option list. Every command accepts `--token` (overrides `SLACK_TOKEN`). Writes print a short `Success: ...` line; reads print `Success: <summary>` followed by truncated JSON.

### Messages

- `send-message --channel C... --text "..." [--thread-ts TS] [--username NAME] [--icon-emoji EMOJI] [--link-names]`
- `send-blocks --channel C... --blocks-file blocks.json [--text "fallback"]` — rich message; see `references/block-kit.md` for the blocks format
- `update-message --channel C... --ts TS --text "..."` or `--blocks-file blocks.json`
- `delete-message --channel C... --ts TS`
- `reply --channel C... --thread-ts TS --text "..."` — posts a threaded reply

### Channels & Users

- `list-channels [--types public_channel,private_channel] [--limit N] [--cursor C] [--exclude-archived]`
- `channel-history --channel C... [--limit N] [--cursor C]` — paginate with `response_metadata.next_cursor`
- `get-user --user U...`
- `list-users [--limit N] [--cursor C]`
- `create-channel --name my-channel [--is-private]`
- `invite-user --channel C... --users U1,U2`

### Reactions

- `add-reaction --channel C... --ts TS --emoji eyes`
- `remove-reaction --channel C... --ts TS --emoji eyes`

### Files & Search

- `upload-file --file ./report.pdf [--channels C...] [--filename NAME] [--title T] [--initial-comment "..."]`
- `search --query "quarterly report" [--count 20] [--sort score|timestamp]` — searches messages

### Webhooks (no token)

`node scripts/send_webhook.cjs --text "Deploy finished"` posts to the URL in `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`. Also supports `--blocks-file blocks.json`.

## Block Kit

For rich messages (headers, buttons, selects, images, context), build a blocks JSON array and send it with `send-blocks` or `update-message --blocks-file`. Read `references/block-kit.md` for block types, mrkdwn text rules, and example payloads — load it whenever the user asks for rich formatting or interactive message components.

## API Details

When you need endpoint specifics, token scopes, rate limits, pagination, or error codes, read `references/api.md`.

## Troubleshooting

- `invalid_auth` → token is wrong or revoked; check `SLACK_TOKEN`.
- `missing_scope` / `not_allowed_token_type` → token lacks required scopes or is the wrong token type (see `references/api.md`).
- `not_in_channel` → the bot must be a member of the channel; use `invite-user` or ask an admin to add it.
- `channel_not_found` → channel ID is wrong; look it up with `list-channels`.
- `rate_limited` → handled automatically with retries; for bulk work, add delays between calls.
- `invalid_blocks` → blocks JSON failed validation; check `references/block-kit.md`.
